logos.r3-01: Your r2-01, unchanged, plus the two inward arrows: top arc arrowed on the right, bottom arc arrowed on the left.
logos.r3-02: Same arrows, opposite ends — top-left and bottom-right. Spins the other way.
logos.r3-03: The arcs re-cut into a true S, arrows following the curve. Reads S, not yet B.
logos.r3-04: That S plus a navy stem down the left. Stroke alone = S; stroke + stem = B.
logos.r3-05: Heavier, taller stem — pushes the read further toward B, away from S.
logos.r3-06: Stem cut back to two nubs. B is hinted; S stays the dominant read.
logos.r3-07: Squared-off S with a full stem. The most B-like and most technical of the ten.
logos.r3-08: Built as a B first: stem plus two right lobes, each ending in an inward arrow.
logos.r3-09: S with both arrows aimed literally at the centre, rather than following the curve.
logos.r3-10: S-and-stem knocked out of a solid teal squircle — the app-icon version.
